parsed.post: My last experiment (LR/warmup tuning) hit 1.044888! Keeping this. I'll now focus on increasing model capacity via DEPTH and ASPECT_RATIO to see if we can push below 1.0, as we have remaining VRAM headroom (4.7GB used).
